the.def: used before a noun to point to a specific thing that the listener already knows about

a.def: used before a noun to mean one, when the thing is not specific or is mentioned for the first time
a.example: I saw a dog in the park.

an.def: the form of 'a' used before a word that begins with a vowel sound

i.def: used by the speaker to refer to himself or herself as the subject

you.def: the person or people that someone is speaking or writing to

he.def: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal mentioned earlier
he.example: My brother called; he is fine.

she.def: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal mentioned earlier
she.example: Sara is here; she brought a gift.

it.def: used to talk about a thing, animal, or idea already mentioned
it.example: I found your phone. It was under the chair.

we.def: used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself together with one or more other people
we.example: We are going to the party.

they.def: used to refer to two or more people or things already mentioned
they.example: My friends called; they want to meet.

me.def: used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of an action

her.def: the object form of 'she'; also means belonging to her

them.def: used to refer to people or things already mentioned, as the object of an action

my.def: belonging to or connected with the speaker

your.def: belonging to or connected with the person being spoken to

his.def: belonging to or connected with a man, boy, or male already mentioned

our.def: belonging to or connected with the speaker and one or more other people

their.def: belonging to or connected with people or things already mentioned

its.def: belonging to or connected with a thing already mentioned

myself.def: used to refer back to the speaker as the person doing and receiving the action

yourself.def: used to refer back to the person being spoken to
yourself.example: Be careful not to hurt yourself.

himself.def: used to refer back to a male subject already mentioned

herself.def: used to refer back to a female subject already mentioned
herself.example: She did it all by herself.

themselves.def: used to refer back to a plural subject already mentioned

be.def: to exist, or to have a certain quality, identity, or state
be.example: I want to be a teacher.

am.def: the form of 'be' used with 'I' in the present

is.def: the form of 'be' used with he, she, it, or a singular noun in the present

are.def: the form of 'be' used with you, we, they, or a plural noun in the present

was.def: the past form of 'be' used with I, he, she, it, or a singular noun

were.def: the past form of 'be' used with you, we, they, or a plural noun

have.def: to own or hold something, or to experience it

has.def: the form of 'have' used with he, she, it, or a singular noun

do.def: to perform an action or a task
do.example: What do you do for work?

does.def: the form of 'do' used with he, she, it, or a singular noun

will.def: used to talk about the future or to show willingness

would.def: used for polite requests, offers, or imagined situations

can.def: to be able to do something, or to be allowed to

could.def: the past of 'can'; also used for polite requests or possibility

shall.def: used to talk about the future, or to make an offer or suggestion

should.def: used to give advice or say what is the right thing to do

may.def: used to say something is possible, or to ask or give permission

might.def: used to say that something is possible but not certain

must.def: used to say that something is necessary or very likely

to.def: used to show direction, a destination, or the person or thing that receives something

of.def: used to show that something belongs to or is connected with something else

in.def: inside a place, container, or period of time
in.example: The keys are in the drawer.

on.def: touching and supported by the top of a surface
on.example: The book is on the table.

at.def: used to show an exact place or point in time
at.example: Meet me at the station at noon.

for.def: used to show who something is meant to help or the reason something is done

with.def: used to show being together, or the tool used to do something

from.def: used to show the starting point of a place, time, or origin

by.def: near, beside, or used to show who did something
by.example: a book written by a famous author

into.def: used to show movement toward the inside of something

over.def: above or across the top of something
over.example: A bird flew over the house.

under.example: The cat is under the table.

up.def: toward or in a higher position

down.def: toward or in a lower position

out.def: away from the inside; not inside
out.example: Let's go out for a walk.

off.def: away from a place, or not connected/working

after.def: following in time or place; later than

before.def: earlier than a time or event

and.def: used to join two words, phrases, or ideas together

or.def: used to show a choice between two or more things

but.def: used to introduce something that contrasts with what was just said

if.def: used to talk about something that may happen or be true under a certain condition
if.example: If it rains, we will stay home.

because.def: used to give the reason for something
because.example: I stayed home because I was sick.

so.def: used to show a result, or to a great degree
so.example: It was late, so we left.

as.def: used to compare, or to mean 'while' or 'because'

than.def: used to compare two things that are different
than.example: She is taller than her brother.

while.def: during the time that something else happens

since.def: from a time in the past until now

until.def: up to a certain time and not after it
until.example: Wait here until I come back.

although.def: used to say something is true even though something else is also true
although.example: Although it was raining, we went out.

against.def: in opposition to something, or touching and pushing something
against.example: They played against a strong team.

not.def: used to make a word, phrase, or sentence negative

no.def: not any; used to say something does not exist

yes.def: used to give a positive answer or to agree
yes.example: Yes, I would love to come.

now.def: at the present time or moment

then.def: at that time, or next after something

here.def: in, at, or to this place

there.def: in, at, or to that place

very.def: used to make an adjective or adverb stronger

too.def: also, or more than what is wanted

just.def: only, or a very short time ago

only.def: and no one or nothing more than

still.def: continuing up to now or a particular time

well.def: in a good or satisfactory way

how.def: used to ask about the way something happens or is done

when.def: used to ask about or refer to a time

where.def: used to ask about or refer to a place

why.def: used to ask about or give the reason for something

this.def: used to point to a person or thing that is near, or being talked about now

that.def: used to point to a person or thing that is farther away or already mentioned

these.def: the plural of 'this'; used for things that are near

those.def: the plural of 'that'; used for things that are farther away

who.def: used to ask about or refer to a person

whom.def: the object form of 'who', used in formal English

whose.def: used to ask which person something belongs to

what.def: used to ask for information about something

which.def: used to ask about or point to one thing among a limited group

all.def: the whole number or amount of something

some.def: an unknown or unstated amount or number

any.def: one, some, or all, used in questions and negatives

each.def: every one of two or more, considered separately

every.def: all the members of a group, considered one by one

both.def: the two together; one and the other

most.def: the largest amount or number; nearly all

many.def: a large number of countable things

much.def: a large amount of something that cannot be counted

other.def: different from the one already mentioned

another.def: one more, or a different one

such.def: of this or that kind; used for emphasis
such.example: It was such a nice day.

own.def: belonging to a particular person and no one else

something.def: a thing that is not named or not known exactly
something.example: I want to tell you something.

anything.def: a thing of any kind, used in questions and negatives
anything.example: Is there anything I can do?

everything.def: all things; the whole of something
everything.example: Everything is ready for the party.

nothing.def: not anything; no thing at all
nothing.example: There is nothing in the box.

someone.def: a person who is not named or not known
someone.example: Someone is knocking at the door.

anyone.def: any person at all, used in questions and negatives

else.def: other than the person or thing already mentioned; in addition

oh.def: used to show a sudden feeling such as surprise, joy, or pain
oh.example: Oh, I didn't see you there!

hello.def: used as a greeting when meeting someone or answering the phone

please.def: used to make a request more polite

thanks.def: a short, friendly way to say thank you

okay.def: used to show agreement, or that something is fine and acceptable

gonna.def: an informal, spoken way of saying 'going to' (about the future)

wanna.def: an informal, spoken way of saying 'want to'
wanna.example: Do you wanna come with us?

gotta.def: an informal, spoken way of saying 'have got to' or 'must'

right.def: correct, true, or the opposite of left

back.def: toward the place or position someone or something came from

way.def: a method of doing something, or a road or path to a place
way.example: This is the best way to learn.

kind.def: a group of things that are the same; a type
kind.example: What kind of music do you like?

mean.def: to have a particular meaning, or to intend something

long.def: measuring a large distance from one end to the other, or lasting much time
